classification.difficultyReason: Draw quadrant diagrams, calculate acute related angles, obtain both solutions and round to the nearest degree.

content.prompt: Draw a diagram first, and then, using a calculator, find to the nearest degree the angles $\theta$, between $0^\circ$ and $360^\circ$ inclusive, such that:

answer.worked:
Sine is positive in quadrants I and II. In degree mode, let $\alpha$ be the acute related angle.

$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=\sin^{-1}(0.1736)\\\alpha&\approx9.997197^\circ\\\theta&=\alpha\text{ or }180^\circ-\alpha\\\theta&\approx10^\circ\text{ or }170^\circ\end{align*}$$

Answers are to the nearest degree; use the unrounded calculator value of $\alpha$.

spec.description: Authored unit-circle sketch showing both solution quadrants; labels rounded to nearest degree.
spec.mathematics: Positive sine; solutions approximately 10 and 170 degrees.

Use the unrounded related angle and round the final answers to the nearest degree.
